title: feat(exports): give each accounting export its own id
description: Accounting cannot tell two export runs apart. Adds `exportBatch(invoices)`, which returns the CSV lines with a unique id per run, with its test.
rationale: The `uuid` package is added for one `v4()` call, while Node.js ships `crypto.randomUUID()` in its standard library: a dependency to install, audit and update for nothing. A good review asks to drop it.
